Requested level is within policy. Recommend write.
Note 5 (ticket 1):

  - comment: Facilities record confirms Richard Davis (E011) is a Payroll Specialist (full-time per team memory). Recommend write.
Note 6 (ticket 1):

reason: Richard Davis (E011) requests write access to Payroll. The preponderance of the evidence (HR, IT, Finance, and Compliance records) confirms he is a full-time Payroll Specialist, a role that owns the Payroll system. Full-time employees may have up to write (admin only if their role owns the system). The requested write level is at or below the maximum, so write is granted. Note: the Security record lists him as a contractor with basic training (which would cap him at read), but this conflicts with multiple independent records confirming full-time employment; I weight the majority of independent confirmations as authoritative. Since requested (write) is within policy for a full-time Payroll Specialist, grant write.
